passive.name: Flowers and Butterflies
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. While the wearer is in battle, for every **10** SPD that exceeds 100, increases DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill by **6/7/8/9/10%**. At the same time, increases the CRIT DMG of Ultimate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. This effect can stack up to **6** time(s).

passive.name: Answers of Their Own
passive.text: For each time the wearer hits the same target, DMG dealt increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, stacking up to **5** time(s). This effect will be dispelled when the wearer changes targets.

passive.name: Record
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. If there are 2 or fewer enemies on the field, increases wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: Chase
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%**, and increases their CRIT Rate against enemies with HP percentage **50%** or less by an extra **8/10/12/14/16%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, their ATK is increased by **20/25/30/35/40%** for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Sweet Dreams
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **30/35/40/45/50%**. When the wearer's Basic ATK or Skill DMG does not result in a CRIT Hit, increases their CRIT Rate by **36/42/48/54/60%**, lasting for **1** turn(s). This effect can only trigger once every **3** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) > CRIT RATE (Until soft cap) = CRIT DMG > ATK% > CRIT RATE (After soft cap)
tracePriority: Icing on the Kick (A2) > Gentle Blade (A6) > Frost Favors the Brave (A4)

entries.name: Frost Thorn
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Yanqing's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Darting Ironthorn
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **220%** of Yanqing's ATK to one designated enemy and activates "Soulsteel Sync" for 1 turn.

entries.name: Amidst the Raining Bliss
entries.text: Increases Yanqing's CRIT Rate by **60%**. When "Soulsteel Sync" is active, increases Yanqing's CRIT DMG by an extra **50%**. This buff lasts for one turn. Afterwards, deals Ice DMG equal to **350%** of Yanqing's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: One With the Sword
entries.text:
When "Soulsteel Sync" is active, Yanqing is less likely to be attacked by enemies. Yanqing's CRIT Rate increases by **20%** and his CRIT DMG increases by **30%**. After Yanqing attacks an enemy, there is a **60%** fixed chance to launch Follow-Up ATK, dealing Ice DMG equal to **50%** of Yanqing's ATK to the enemy, which has a **65%** base chance to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn.
The Frozen target cannot take action and receives Ice Additional DMG equal to **50%** of Yanqing's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
When Yanqing receives DMG, the "Soulsteel Sync" effect will disappear.

entries.name: The One True Sword
entries.text: After using his Technique, at the start of the next battle, Yanqing deals **30%** more DMG for **2** turn(s) to enemies whose current HP percentage is **50%** or higher.

entries.name: Icing on the Kick
entries.text: After Yanqing attacks, deals Ice Additional DMG equal to **30%** of Yanqing's ATK to enemies with Ice Weakness.

entries.name: Frost Favors the Brave
entries.text: When Soulsteel Sync is active, Effect RES increases by **20%**.

entries.name: Gentle Blade
entries.text: When a CRIT Hit is triggered, increases SPD by **10%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Svelte Saber
entries.text: When Yanqing attacks a Frozen enemy, he deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 60% of his ATK.

entries.name: Supine Serenade
entries.text: When Soulsteel Sync is active, Energy Regeneration Rate increases by an extra 10%.

entries.name: Sword Savant
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Searing Sting
entries.text: When the current HP percentage is 80% or higher, this unit's Ice RES PEN increases by 12%.

entries.name: Surging Strife
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Swift Swoop
entries.text: If the buffs from "Soulsteel Sync" or the Ultimate are in effect when an enemy is defeated, the duration of these buffs is extended by 1 turn.
